title: Hearing That Dude Say 'Grand Theft Auto' At The End Of The Latest GTA 6 Trailer Made Me Feel Like This
summary: Hello old friend, its been a bit
text: Hearing That Dude Say 'Grand Theft Auto' At The End Of The Latest GTA 6 Trailer Made Me Feel Like This Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals Commentary Hearing That Dude Say ‘Grand Theft Auto’ At The End Of The Latest GTA 6 Trailer Made Me Feel Like This Hello old friend, its been a bit Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 Rockstar Games By Zack Zwiezen Published October 15, 2026 | Comments ( 0 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Pixar / Kotaku Earlier today, Rockstar Games released the launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6. It’s a good trailer that includes some steamy moments between Jason and Lucia . It also features a Grand Theft Auto tradition at the very end: The same dude saying the game’s name at the end in a deep voice. On October 15, Rockstar dropped a new GTA 6 trailer which will likely be used heavily by Rockstar for advertising on TV and elsewhere. And as such, unlike past GTA 6 trailers, this one features a narrator at the very end chiming in to tell you the game’s name and when it will launch, as well as its ESRB rating. You can hear it below. For all the longtime GTA fans, like myself, who have grown up playing these games and getting hyped for each new release, that voice is extremely comforting as we’ve heard it many, many times before. Since Grand Theft Auto 3, each GTA launch trailer has featured, at the very end, seemingly the same dude and his deep voice. In GTA 3 and Vice City’s trailers, Rockstar hadn’t quite nailed the formula yet. But starting with San Andreas, the classic “ GRAND THEFT AUTO …” ending narration had fully developed. Since then, that dude and his voice have appeared in the launch trailers for Liberty City Stories, Vice City Stories, GTA IV, and GTA V . Rockstar has also included this bit of narration in the launch trailers for Red Dead Redemption and RDR2 . I was truly surprised by how nostalgic I felt the moment I heard that familiar voice pop up at the end of the new GTA 6 trailer and say: “ GRAND THEFT AUTO 6 . COMING NOVEMBER 19. RATED M FOR MATURE.” I felt like the critic in that famous scene in Ratatouille who, after taking a bite of a dish he loved as a child, was suddenly transported back in time. The moment I heard his voice in that new trailer, I was 13 again. I was watching something on my shitty little TV and seeing the ad for the next GTA game pop up and hearing that guy’s voice. Rockstar only brings out this dude when the game is truly ready to go, so any time I heard it when I was younger, I got so pumped. If you were worried about a last-minute delay, don’t be. The deep voice has assured us all that Grand Theft Auto 6 will arrive on November 19. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter.
